python.package: IntRangeSlider, HTML, VBox for date range UI

constraints.constraint: Prevention by Design: IntRangeSlider constrains input to valid year range (2000-2024), no error handling needed
UI Framework: Use ipywidgets (not ipyvuetify) for all widgets
Performance tip thresholds: ≤5 years = Fast, 6-10 years = Medium, >10 years = Large
Widget callbacks use observe() pattern with names='value'
AnalysisState.year_start and year_end already defined with defaults 2019 and 2023
WidgetFactory is in tip4patlibs_core.py, notebook imports from module
